name: list_project_routes
description:
Get the routing rules for a project. Supports searching by name/ID/pattern, filtering by route type, and diffing staged changes against production.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{projectId}/routes --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.
